Done — I refreshed the UI and split some of the server-side routing into a smaller file, without changing the app’s behavior.

What changed:
- Updated the styling in `public/styles.css` for a more modern look:
  - softer gradients/background
  - glassy sticky header
  - rounded cards and buttons
  - improved spacing, focus states, and shadows
- Kept shared frontend helpers in `public/common.js`
- Moved page route wiring out of `src/server.js` into:
  - `src/routes/pages.js`
- Simplified `src/server.js` to focus on app setup and middleware
- Kept all existing functionality and page structure the same

I also sanity-checked the server entry point, but the container doesn’t have dependencies installed, so I couldn’t fully run the app here.
